briefs.title: Stocks slip as Nvidia CEO exit and jump in Treasury yields weigh; small caps lag
briefs.summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.4% to 7,592.4, the Nasdaq fell 0.4% and the Dow fell 0.4%. Small caps fared worse, with the Russell 2000 down 1.7%. Nvidia's CEO departure and a sharp rise in Treasury yields on rate-hike bets dominate
